obligations.expected_behavior: When Quick Dev recommendation-only mode is invoked, read an explicit current snapshot before producing the recommendation.
obligations.observable_result: The recommendation flow has consumed the explicit current snapshot.
obligations.state_after: The explicit current snapshot has been read.
obligations.state_before: Quick Dev recommendation-only mode has been invoked and the current snapshot has not yet been read.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev recommendation-only mode
obligations.trigger: Invocation of Quick Dev recommendation-only mode

obligations.expected_behavior: Distinguish observations in the current snapshot that remain reusable from observations that have been invalidated.
obligations.observable_result: The recommendation distinguishes reusable observations from invalidated observations.
obligations.state_after: Snapshot observations are classified as reusable or invalidated.
obligations.state_before: The current snapshot has been read, but its observations have not yet been distinguished by validity.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev recommendation-only mode
obligations.trigger: After reading the explicit current snapshot
